shortDescription: Adds or removes postgresql users from proxysql admin interface

options.name: active
options.description: A user with I(active) set to C(False) will be tracked in the database, but will be never loaded in the in-memory data structures. If omitted the proxysql database default for I(active) is C(True).

options.name: backend
options.description: If I(backend) is set to C(True), this (username, password) pair is used for authenticating to the ProxySQL instance.

options.name: config_file
options.description: Specify a config file from which I(login_user) and I(login_password) are to be read.

options.name: default_hostgroup
options.description: If there is no matching rule for the queries sent by this user, the traffic it generates is sent to the specified hostgroup. If omitted the proxysql database default for I(default_hostgroup) is 0.

options.name: fast_forward
options.description: If I(fast_forward) is set to C(True), I(fast_forward) will bypass the query processing layer (rewriting, caching) and pass through the query directly as is to the backend server. If omitted the proxysql database default for I(fast_forward) is C(False).

options.name: frontend
options.description: If I(frontend) is set to C(True), this (username, password) pair is used for authenticating to the PostgreSQL servers against any hostgroup.

options.name: load_to_runtime
options.description: Dynamically load config to runtime memory.

options.name: login_host
options.description: The host used to connect to ProxySQL admin interface.

options.name: login_password
options.description: The password used to authenticate to ProxySQL admin interface.

options.name: login_port
options.description: The port used to connect to ProxySQL admin interface.

options.name: login_unix_socket
options.description: The socket used to connect to ProxySQL admin interface.

options.name: login_user
options.description: The username used to authenticate to ProxySQL admin interface.

options.name: max_connections
options.description: The maximum number of connections ProxySQL will open to the backend for this user. If omitted the proxysql database default for I(max_connections) is 10000.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of the user connecting to the postgresql or ProxySQL instance.

options.name: save_to_disk
options.description: Save config to sqlite db on disk to persist the configuration.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present) - adds the user, when C(absent) - removes the user.

options.name: transaction_persistent
options.description: If this is set for the user with which the PostgreSQL client is connecting to ProxySQL (thus a "frontend" user), transactions started within a hostgroup will remain within that hostgroup regardless of any other rules. If omitted the proxysql database default for I(transaction_persistent) is C(True).

options.name: use_ssl
options.description: If I(use_ssl) is set to C(True), connections by this user will be made using SSL connections. If omitted the proxysql database default for I(use_ssl) is C(False).

options.name: username
options.description: Name of the user connecting to the postgresql or ProxySQL instance.
